statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of symptomatic bradycardia and pauses consistent with sick sinus syndrome
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is ordered to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and guide further management
The diagnosis codes are I47.1, I48.91, and I49.5
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
